title: Appointed as Assistant
original: We've got more kitties! Yeah…

title: Talk 1
original: Laterano cakes are so delicious! But we operators have to pay attention to our diet, right?... aww...

title: Talk 2
original: Not my gloves... I'm sorry, I can't take my gloves off... I don't want you to see my hands. That's the one thing I ask... sorry…

title: Talk 3
original: A-Are we departing now? Al-Alright, let me just prepare one moment...!

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Do you think it's odd that I have two tails? Do-do-do I look even stranger than I thought? Umm...

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: When my symptoms aren't flaring up, my hand stays all normal... It feels so nice, just being able to hold the kitties like this...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Doctor, what kind of cake do you prefer? Mango, or matcha? I tried making a few, and... you already ate? Oh, umm, Okay...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: D-Doctor! Sora... sh-she's the super idol, Sora, isn't she?! I'd recognize her anywhere! I'm her biggest fan! Why is she here at Rhodes Island? And... and... can I ask her for an autograph?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor, have you heard of the Avenue des Champs-Élysées? Yes, I happened to be born there. I really wish I could go back and visit one day... what? Oh, no, I appreciate it, but I'm not lonely. I have you, after all! You're my family.

title: Idle
original: Aw... Doctor... why are you ignoring me...

title: Onboard
original: Good day... p-please call me Mousse. And... and please don't stare at my hand so much...

title: Watching Battle Record
original: This is a favor I'll never forget!

title: Promotion 1
original: Huh? Pro...promotion?! I-I'm not prepared for this...

title: Promotion 2
original: Doctor, I know there's a limit to what I can accomplish, so I swear... I'll do all that I'm able, as well as I'm able! It's... It's the only way I could ever repay you, Doctor...

title: Added to Squad
original: Yes, I'll do my best!

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: This is in my hands! You can do this, Mousse!

title: Depart
original: I essentially blend into the walls, so I'm a good choice for scouting...

title: Begin Operation
original: Scouting complete. Sending you enemy coordinates.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I'm ready!

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Here!

title: Deployment 1
original: I'm not scared...!

title: Deployment 2
original: From now on, this is my battle...!

title: In Battle 1
original: Yah!

title: In Battle 2
original: No, stay back!

title: In Battle 3
original: I can fight too!

title: In Battle 4
original: You-You'll regret this!

title: 4-star Result
original: It was a tough fight... but I stayed steady through it all...!

title: 3-star Result
original: Yay... Oh, oh, sorry, it's not that I like battles that much, but...

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: D-Did I drag us all down?

title: Operation Failure
original: I can... keep going...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: E-Excuse me... May I come in...?

title: Tap
original: Yah!

title: Trust Tap
original: D-Doctor... I really can't hold it in anymore... do we have a scratching post? Urghh...

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy new year, Doctor… Help yourself with the pastries there! I personally made some of them, and they go well with the tea I prepared. With my gloves on me though... they may not look as great as what I used to make. B-But should still taste good, I think!

title: Greeting
original: Hello, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, could you accept this felt doll? I made it with the fur those kittens left behind. It was a lot of fur for a small doll, so I tried a few times to get it right. Do you recognize it, Doctor? It's you... N-No? Aw…

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Sora just gave me more of her albums, and they also came with her signature on them! How nice of her! She also gave me this little heart-shaped doodle on my gloves, saying these are the coolest gloves she's ever seen, and that I looked really special with them. Doctor, I'm thinking, maybe... I'm not as weird as I thought?
